_source: Data/_variable_descriptions.csv from RDS-2013-0009.7_Data_Format3_GPKG.zip (FPA-FOD 7th edition, 1992-2024). Authoritative upstream domains; extracted verbatim, never hand-written (#294).
_note: NWCG_GENERAL_CAUSE and OWNER_DESCR carry NO upstream domain values - they are enumerated from the ingested data via the duckdb-geo MCP and filled in by gen_stac.py from data_domains below.

descriptions.Fires:FPA_ID: Unique identifier that contains information necessary to track back to the original record in the source dataset.
descriptions.Fires:SOURCE_SYSTEM_TYPE: Type of source database or system that the record was drawn from.
descriptions.Fires:SOURCE_SYSTEM: Name of or other identifier for source database or system that the record was drawn from. See \Supplements\FPA_FOD_source_list.pdf for a list of sources and their identifier and Short (2014) for additional source information.
descriptions.Fires:NWCG_REPORTING_AGENCY: Active National Wildlife Coordinating Group (NWCG) Unit Identifier for the agency preparing the fire report.
descriptions.Fires:NWCG_REPORTING_UNIT_ID: Active NWCG Unit Identifier for the unit preparing the fire report.
descriptions.Fires:NWCG_REPORTING_UNIT_NAME: Active NWCG Unit Name for the unit preparing the fire report.
descriptions.Fires:SOURCE_REPORTING_UNIT: Code for the agency unit preparing the fire report, based on code/name in the source dataset.
descriptions.Fires:SOURCE_REPORTING_UNIT_NAME: Name of reporting agency unit preparing the fire report, based on code/name in the source dataset.
descriptions.Fires:LOCAL_FIRE_REPORT_ID: Number or code that uniquely identifies an incident report for a particular reporting unit and a particular calendar year.
descriptions.Fires:LOCAL_INCIDENT_ID: Number or code that uniquely identifies an incident for a particular local fire management organization within a particular calendar year.
descriptions.Fires:FIRE_CODE: Code used within the interagency wildland fire community to track and compile cost information for emergency fire suppression expenditures (https://www.firecode.gov/).
descriptions.Fires:FIRE_NAME: Name of the incident, from the fire report (primary) or ICS-209 report (secondary).
descriptions.Fires:ICS_209_PLUS_INCIDENT_JOIN_ID: Primary identifier needed to join into operational situation reporting data for the incident in the ICS-209-PLUS dataset.
descriptions.Fires:ICS_209_PLUS_COMPLEX_JOIN_ID: If part of a complex, secondary identifier potentially needed to join to operational situation reporting data for the incident in the ICS-209-PLUS dataset.
descriptions.Fires:MTBS_ID: Incident identifier, from the Monitoring Trends in Burn Severity (MTBS) perimeter dataset.
descriptions.Fires:MTBS_FIRE_NAME: Name of the incident, from the MTBS perimeter dataset.
descriptions.Fires:COMPLEX_NAME: Name of the complex under which the fire was ultimately managed, when discernible.
descriptions.Fires:FIRE_YEAR: Calendar year in which the fire was discovered or confirmed to exist.
descriptions.Fires:DISCOVERY_DATE: Date on which the fire was discovered or confirmed to exist.
descriptions.Fires:DISCOVERY_DOY: Day of year on which the fire was discovered or confirmed to exist.
descriptions.Fires:DISCOVERY_TIME: Time of day that the fire was discovered or confirmed to exist.
descriptions.Fires:NWCG_CAUSE_CLASSIFICATION: Broad classification of the reason the fire occurred
descriptions.Fires:NWCG_GENERAL_CAUSE: Event or circumstance that started a fire or set the stage for its occurrence.
descriptions.Fires:NWCG_CAUSE_AGE_CATEGORY: If cause attributed to children (ages 0-12) or adolescents (13-17), the value for this data element is set to Minor; otherwise null.
descriptions.Fires:CONT_DATE: Date on which the fire was declared contained or otherwise controlled (mm/dd/yyyy where mm=month, dd=day, and yyyy=year).
descriptions.Fires:CONT_DOY: Day of year (1-366) on which the fire was declared contained or otherwise controlled.
descriptions.Fires:CONT_TIME: Time of day that the fire was declared contained or otherwise controlled (hhmm where hh=hour, mm=minutes).
descriptions.Fires:FIRE_SIZE: The estimate of acres within the final perimeter of the fire.
descriptions.Fires:FIRE_SIZE_CLASS: Code for fire size based on the number of acres within the final fire perimeter.
descriptions.Fires:LATITUDE: Latitude (NAD 83) for point location (origin) of the fire (decimal degrees).
descriptions.Fires:LONGITUDE: Longitude (NAD 83) for point location (origin) of the fire (decimal degrees).
descriptions.Fires:OWNER_DESCR: Name of primary owner or entity responsible for managing the land at the point of origin of the fire at the time of the incident.
descriptions.Fires:STATE: Two-letter alphabetic code for the state in which the fire burned (or originated), based on the nominal designation in the fire report (not from a spatial overlay).
descriptions.Fires:COUNTY: County, or equivalent, in which the fire burned (or originated), based on nominal designation in the fire report (not from a spatial overlay).
descriptions.Fires:FIPS_CODE: Five-digit code from the Federal Information Process Standards (FIPS) publication 6-4 for representation of counties and equivalent entities, based on the nominal designation in the fire report (not from a spatial overlay).
descriptions.Fires:FIPS_NAME: County name from the FIPS publication 6-4 for representation of counties and equivalent entities, based on the nominal designation in the fire report (not from a spatial overlay).
descriptions.units:UnitId: Unique unit identifier assigned by the National Wildfire Coordinating Group (NWCG).
descriptions.units:GeographicArea: Two-letter code for the geographic area in which the unit is located.
descriptions.units:GACC: Six- to eight-letter code for the Geographic Area Coordination Center in which the unit is located or primarily affiliated with.
descriptions.units:WildlandRole: Role of the unit within the wildland fire community.
descriptions.units:UnitType: Type of unit (e.g., federal, state, local).
descriptions.units:Department: Department (or state/territory) to which the unit belongs.
descriptions.units:Agency: Agency or bureau to which the unit belongs.
descriptions.units:Country: Country in which the unit is located.
descriptions.units:State: Two-letter code for the state in which the unit is located (or primarily affiliated).
descriptions.units:Code: Unit code (follows state code to create UnitId).
descriptions.units:Name: Unit name.

Fires:NWCG_CAUSE_CLASSIFICATION.Missing data/not specified/undetermined: Cause of the fire is missing, not specified, or underdetermined

Fires:NWCG_CAUSE_AGE_CATEGORY.Minor: Fire caused by a minor, defined as: children (ages 0-12) or adolescents (13-17)
Fires:NWCG_CAUSE_AGE_CATEGORY.Null: Fire not caused by a minor

Fires:FIRE_SIZE_CLASS.A: Greater than 0 but less than or equal to 0.25 acres

units:GACC.AUVIVIIC: Australasian Fire and Emergency Service Authorities

units:Agency.BSEE: Bureau of Safety and Environmental Enforcement
units:Agency.CDF: California Department of Forestry & Fire Protection
units:Agency.DFF: Division of Forestry, Fire & State Lands
units:Agency.DNRC: Department of Natural Resources and Conservation
units:Agency.DNRF: Department of Natural Resources Forest Service
units:Agency.USACE: United States Army Corps of Engineers

data_domains._source: Enumerated from the ingested 7th-edition Fires layer (fpa-fod-stage-raw schema probe, 2026-08-25; N=2,661,383). Upstream _variable_descriptions.csv carries no domain for these columns, so they are discovered from data, never written from memory (#294).
Fires:NWCG_GENERAL_CAUSE: Misuse of fire by a minor
data_domains._verified: Cross-checked against the ingested parquet 2026-08-25: SOURCE_SYSTEM_TYPE (3), NWCG_REPORTING_AGENCY (11), NWCG_CAUSE_CLASSIFICATION (3), FIRE_SIZE_CLASS (7), NWCG_GENERAL_CAUSE (13) and OWNER_DESCR (17) all match exactly. NWCG_CAUSE_AGE_CATEGORY holds only 'Minor' in data; upstream's 'Null' is documentation, not a stored value.
